text:
Rina Kapoor: Quick thread to bootstrap the cloud marketplace offers. Scope: AWS/GCP/Azure staging only. Target: trial SKU + paid SKU draft by EOD.
Omar Velasquez: I'll own the artifact uploads (AMI/GCR/VHD) and manifest. Need the final SKU ids.
June Park: Use sku ids: rw-trial-21d and rw-standard. Trial = 21 days, free-credit tag.
marketplace-bot: Pre-scan: missing artifacts for Azure offer package and GCP image family. Found container (gcr) and AWS AMI in us-east-1 pending share. Link: https://redwood.example.com/marketplace/scan/2430123456
Omar Velasquez: Copy. I'll publish GCR image and export VHD tonight. Will post AMI id once shared.
Rina Kapoor: Legal/Privacy: June, can you draft a short privacy blurb and vendor addendum? We want default minimal telemetry.
June Park: Drafting now. Privacy blurb: "We collect anonymized inference metrics (latency, model_id, token_counts) for billing and reliability. Customer content is not stored unless explicitly enabled."
Rina Kapoor: Add sentence about opt-in content logging via customer-managed S3 with explicit consent.
infra-ops: Reminder: Azure publisher needs CSV sku->entitlement mapping. Example row: rw-trial-21d,TRIAL,21,free-credit. Also confirm offer manifest schema version 2.
Omar Velasquez: Will include CSV. Also embedding a simple offer.yml template in the manifest.
Rina Kapoor: Action list: Omar = upload artifacts + link AMI by 8pm PT, June = legal + privacy by 6pm, I'll assemble and submit to staging. Quick sync tomorrow 9:30am PT to validate.
Omar Velasquez: Noted, posting artifact links when ready.
June Park: Legal note: EU data addendum needed for pay SKU — will add placeholder.
Rina Kapoor: Thanks team. Ping me on Slack if any blocker pops up. :thumbsup:
